name: DeveloperJourney
subtitle: Developer Onboarding & Recovery Observatory
headline: Follow the friction.
description: Replay privacy-safe synthetic onboarding journeys. Compare documentation versions and turn time-to-success, failures and recovery evidence into product improvements.
boundary: Synthetic sessions only. Timing is fixture-defined, not real developer behavior. No tokens, real-user tracking or external API requests.
method: Choose a seed and session count to produce reproducible synthetic events.
Follow quickstart, credentials, first request, error understanding, retry and first useful task.
Validate an event allowlist; reject extra fields, secret-like identifiers and non-synthetic events.
Compare v1/v2 median and p95 first-success time, recovery and drop-offs.
Link improvement recommendations to session evidence and export a clearly labelled local benchmark.
footer: Synthetic by design · privacy by schema · evidence-led recovery
summary: A synthetic-only onboarding analytics system with reproducible journeys, strict privacy validation, first-success and recovery metrics, drop-off taxonomy, documentation-version comparisons and evidence-linked recommendations.
